description: Spends recorded in this wallet's ledger (x402 payments, transfers, auto-pay), newest first, each with its latest outcome (signed, settled, declined, unknown, broadcast, void). The ledger is a hash-chained append-only file when AGENTWALLET_LEDGER or a policy names one; otherwise this process only.

host.description: Only payments to this endpoint host

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only spends at or after it

name: list_payments
